description: This file implements functionality for handling 'remote-ext' commands in Git, including parsing URL syntax, processing escape sequences, and executing commands based on user input. It appears integral to extending Git's remote command capabilities, with functions to initiate communication with remote processes and process their responses.

methods.name: void parse_argv(struct strvec * out,const char * arg,const char * service)
methods.description: Expands the URL argument string into separate arguments, handling escape sequences for command execution.

methods.name: void send_git_request(int stdin_fd,const char * serv,const char * repo,const char * vhost)
methods.description: Constructs and sends a Git protocol request packet to a child process with optional vhost information.

methods.name: int run_child(const char * arg,const char * service)
methods.description: Starts a child process for the remote command, sends requests, and manages data transfer.

methods.name: int command_loop(const char * child)
methods.description: Main loop to process commands received over stdin, handling 'capabilities' and 'connect' commands.

methods.name: int cmd_remote_ext(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Entry point for the 'remote-ext' command, validates arguments and initiates the command loop.

methods.name: char * strip_escapes(const char * str,const char * service,const char ** next)
